messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 2.7-1 released and on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Version 2.7-1 of the NMOF package has been released
and is available from
   https://cran.r-project.org/package=NMOF
and from the Git repository at
   https://gitlab.com/NMOF/NMOF


The NEWS file entry:

  o various minor documentation updates

  o manual has been updated:
    http://enricoschumann.net/NMOF.htm#NMOFmanual

  o there is an additional public repository at
    https://git.sr.ht/~enricoschumann/NMOF



Comments/corrections/remarks/suggestions are -- as
always -- very welcome; please send them to the
maintainer (me) directly.


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
